title: Three Evenings and One Short Spoon
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：liquid　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 liquid 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the cook ① poured the liquid that no guest in the kitchen would have recorded, and he said the pouring was the whole of the evening. The ② liquid, meaning the water itself and not the spoon, ran three evenings and stayed unrecorded in the book; liquid, he said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ drop of liquid in that kitchen had the same short spoon beside it, and the ④ liquid at the far stove, meaning the cup they kept for the children to sip and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Liquid, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the cook said the recording is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the liquid was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the water. The ⑥ liquid, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; liquid, he said, is either something you pour or the only word that means both water and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ liquid had become a line in a recipe, and the recipe had become an argument about the short spoon. The ⑧ liquid of the whole thing, the cook wrote in October, was one kitchen and three evenings of recording; liquid, he said, is either the cup at the far stove or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ liquid I remember is the liquid recorded in the recipe, which closed in 1973 and is still recorded as the quietest in the kitchen. ⑩ Liquid, my mother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all liquid, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like water. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 液体；流质（指灶间里每一滴旁边的那一滴）
B. n. 液体；流质（指那滴液体本身，与勺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：pour the liquid 倒出这些液体
D. n. 液体；流质（指留给孩子们啜饮的那一杯那一滴）
E. n. 汤水之事（抽象总称，指一处灶间的液体之事）
F. n. 液体；流质（指方子里写到、被记载的的那一滴）
G. n. 温热、滋养（指一件事里人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 滋养（抽象总称，指人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: poured the liquid that no guest in the kitchen would have recorded
The liquid, meaning the water itself and not the spoon
Every drop of liquid in that kitchen
the liquid at the far stove
the liquid was the whole of the matter
the liquid had become a line in a recipe
The liquid of the whole thing

answers.why: pour the liquid 意为“倒出这些液体”，1966 年那位厨子把灶间里没有一位客人肯记载的一滴液体做了一遍。
liquid 意为“液体；流质”，指那滴液体本身而不是勺子，它经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
liquid 意为“液体；流质”，指灶间里每一滴旁边的那一滴，每一滴旁边都有同一把小小的勺子。
liquid 意为“液体；流质”，指最远那座灶台留给孩子们啜饮的那一杯那一滴，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
liquid 意为“温热、滋养”，指一件事里人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份滋养就是那件事的全部。
liquid 意为“滋养”，指人人都喝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那滴液体，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
liquid 意为“液体；流质”，指方子里写到、被记载的的那一滴，到 1971 年这一滴成了方子里的一行。
liquid 意为“汤水之事”，厨子十月写道，整件事的液体之事是一处灶间和三个傍晚的记载。
liquid 意为“液体；流质”，我记得的是方子里记载过的那一滴，1973 年倒好了，至今仍被说成灶间里最安静的一滴。
liquid 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，液体是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的液体。
